JULI.PROZ Photo Studio third-party notices

ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1 — Microsoft, MIT license (ONNXRUNTIME-LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.20.1
Runtime files are retrieved from the versioned npm tarball during the build.

U2NetP — Xuebin Qin et al., Apache License 2.0 (U2NET-LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
Model distributed by Daniel Gatis / rembg:
https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/u2netp.onnx

Exact asset SHA-256 values are pinned in scripts/prepare-photo-runtime.cjs.
Photos and inference remain in the browser. No external image API is used.
The model only supplies a foreground alpha mask; source RGB is preserved
unless the administrator explicitly adjusts the light control.
